An '''airless moon'''<ref name="Point AD" /> housed [[Unidentified lunar base|a lunar base]] where the [[service droid]] [[Olly]] operated a [[Fuel|refueling]] bay.<ref name="Point" /> During or after [[18 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TBBDate|311}}</ref> the [[pirate]] [[Phee Genoa]] visited the [[moon]] in her [[starship]], ''[[Providence]]'', to get the vessel refueled. While the ''Providence'' was refueling, [[Clone X trooper]] [[CX-2]] snuck aboard to find the coordiantes for the [[planet]] [[Pabu]] on board Genoa's ship.<ref name="Point" />
